prayerExcerpt.en-US: The beginning of the Gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Princípio do Evangelho de Jesus Cristo, Filho de Deus.

meta.face: Starting from the original painted face, keeping its head angle and lowered gaze: hair turned salt-and-pepper grey and cut shorter; a neat rounded salt-and-pepper beard; face a little broader, around 50.
meta.basis: Greying man with a rounded beard (Painter's Manual).

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
First edit still read like Joseph and Luke (bowed head, brown curls); redone with cropped hair, square jaw and a forward gaze
Second face came out too realistic for the card's painted style; redone as minimal trait changes on the original face
Raising the head to look forward read as looking at the camera; redone keeping the original lowered gaze
